title: Spiral Matrix Traversal
statement:
Given an N×M matrix of integers, print all elements in spiral order: top row left-to-right, right column top-to-bottom, bottom row right-to-left, left column bottom-to-top, then repeat for the inner sub-matrix.

Print all elements on a single line, space-separated.
inputFormat:
Line 1: two integers N and M.
Next N lines: each contains M space-separated integers.
outputFormat: All N*M elements in spiral order on a single line, space-separated.

examples.explanation: Top row: 1 2 3. Right col: 6 9. Bottom row right-to-left: 8 7. Left col bottom-to-top: 4. Center: 5.
Top row: 1 2 3 4. Right col (just 8). Bottom row right-to-left: 7 6 5. Left col: already covered.

starterCode.python:
n, m = map(int, input().split())
matrix = []
for _ in range(n):
    row = list(map(int, input().split()))
    matrix.append(row)
